title: DRAINCODE: Stealthy Energy Consumption Attacks on Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation via Context Poisoning
authors: Yanlin Wang; Jiadong Wu; Tianyue Jiang; Mingwei Liu; Jiachi Chen; Chong Wang; Ensheng Shi; Xilin Liu; Yuchi Ma; Zibin Zheng
why_relevant: Introduces a novel RAG context-poisoning attack targeting computational efficiency (energy/latency) in code generation, expanding the threat model for adversarial corruption of retrieval corpora.
why_not_or_caveat: Domain-specific to code generation and focuses on resource exhaustion rather than content correctness; tangential to mainstream RAG robustness concerns.
